text:
tim_support: FYI AcmeMedia reported a sudden jump in latency and unexpected billing increase. They were on Dedicated (eu-central) but traffic briefly routed to us-west-2 for ~22m. Customer saw +250-450ms and a handful of 5xxs. They claim egress IP rotation in their VPC at the same time. Any quick theories?

sara_oncall: Do we have probe/health events for the window? Need routing trace + health agent logs.

tim_support: Paste of sanitized AcmeMedia probe dump they sent: 
```
probe=hb-9001 time=2026-02-20T02:03:10Z region=eu-central resp=204 latency_ms=72 src_ip=34.89.10.5 forwarded=10.3.2.8 ttl_ms=100
probe=hb-9001 time=2026-02-20T02:03:33Z region=eu-central resp=502 latency_ms=1800 src_ip=34.89.10.6 forwarded=10.3.2.9 ttl_ms=100
route_decision: eu-central -> fallback us-west-2 at 02:03:34 reason=health_unstable
```
They said they rotate 3 ephemeral egress IPs every 12s to avoid carrier throttles.

mira_platform: That pattern smells like our health window treating different src_ip failures as separate host failures and collapsing to overall region fail. Healthcache groups by probe source IP currently; high churn in egress IPs will create intermittent failures that look like a backend outage.

alex_runtime: Also check auth on health request. If some rotated egress IPs transit via a proxy that strips Authorization or toggles TLS, probes can return 401/502. Our failing criteria counts many of those the same. We should differentiate auth failures (4xx) vs server errors (5xx) when deciding failover.

tim_support: They included quick repro steps:
1) provision 3 egress IPs
2) run: curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" \
  'https://eu-central.health.redwood.example/health?token=REDACTED' --resolve eu-central.health.redwood.example:443:34.89.10.5
3) switch resolve to :34.89.10.6 after 12s, then :34.89.10.7
Observed sequence: 204, 502, then route flip to us-west-2.

sara_oncall: Good repro. Two likely fixes: (A) increase consecutive-failure threshold for eu-central for customers using ephemeral egress pools, (B) coalesce probe results by declared backend-id when provided instead of raw src_ip.

mira_platform: Short-term we can add logic to accept a customer-provided header like X-Egress-Tag or X-Backend-Id in the probe URL so healthcache groups by that value. Longer term we should make the health engine aware of NAT pool churn.

alex_runtime: For immediate triage run these commands to fetch traces: 
```
rbctl traces --customer acmemedia --from 2026-02-20T02:00:00Z --to 2026-02-20T02:30:00Z > /tmp/acme-trace.json
rbctl events --type probe --region eu-central --from 2026-02-20T02:00Z --to 2026-02-20T02:30Z | jq -r '.[] | "{time: \(.t)} {id: \(.probe_id)} {status: \(.status)} {src: \(.src_ip)} {lat: \(.latency_ms)}"'
```

luis_billing: Confirmed billing delta — tokens during the us-west-2 reroute were billed at on-demand rates instead of the committed Dedicated rate. We flagged a refund potential. Need engineering confirmation that the platform triggered the reroute.

mira_platform: It was platform-triggered due to perceived health instability. Suggest provisional credit while we implement fix.

tim_support: Agreed short-term mitigations:
- SRE: temporarily raise eu-central consecutive_fail threshold to reduce oscillation (30m window)
- ENG: implement lightweight mapping to fold probe results by X-Backend-Id header and tolerate 4xx auth-mismatch differently in health scoring
- FIN: start provisional credit for AcmeMedia for the affected window
- Support: inform customer and request detailed rbctl trace file

sara_oncall: I'll apply threshold override now and monitor for flips. If stable after an hour I'll roll back. Notify if >2 flips.

ops-bot: scheduled change: healthcache.override.eu-central -> consecutive_failures=6 (deploy in 45s)

john_prod: After we ship backend-id mapping, we should update the Dedicated onboarding docs to recommend either static egress blocks or the X-Backend-Id header for customers who rotate egress IPs. Saves support churn.

tim_support: Thanks team — I'll keep AcmeMedia updated and collect the traces. Will follow up with credits info once finance confirms. Closing loop once we deploy the mapping change. :thumbsup:
